A4018/26 NOTAMN

A) LGGG B) 2611040600 C) 2611041000
E) REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A3956/26 (261216 EUECYIYN OCT 2026).
REF (B) GREEK NOTAM A1638/26 (210805 EUECYIYN MAY 2026).
REF (C) TURKISH NOTAM A4874/26 (301124 EUECYIYN OCT 2026).
NAVIGATIONAL WARNING TO ALL CONCERNED:
THIS NOTAM IS ISSUED TO STATE THAT THE REF (C) TURKISH NOTAM
A4874/26 IS NULL AND VOID SINCE IT REFERS TO MILITARY
ACTIVITIES WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, WHERE THE ONLY COMPETENT
AUTHORITY TO PROMULGATE NOTAMS IN ACCORDANCE WITH THE INTERNATIONAL
RULES AND REGULATIONS IS THE HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER
(HASP) THROUGH ITS APPROPRIATE AIS UNIT AND THE ONLY RESPONSIBLE
AUTHORITY FOR THE SAFETY OF THE AIR TRAFFIC IN THE AREA IS THE
HELLENIC AVIATION SERVICE PROVIDER (HASP) THROUGH THE ATS AND ATC
UNITS.
FURTHERMORE, THE HELLENIC POSITIONS REGARDING THE TURKISH MILITARY
ACTIVITIES ANNOUNCED BY TURKISH NOTAM A2143/26, HAVE ALREADY BEEN EXP
RESSED IN THE REF (B) GREEK NOTAM A1638/26, THEY REMAIN UNCHANGED AND
 THEY ARE THE ONLY VALID AND EFFECTIVE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR, AS WELL AS
 THE REF (A) GREEK NOTAM A3956/26 (261216 EUECYIYN OCT 2026), WHICH I
S FULLY IN FORCE WITHIN ATHINAI FIR.
